name: Model Context Protocol Associate

fee.note: Published exam-only price; includes one retake and 12 months to schedule. A bundle with the THRIVE-ONE annual subscription costs $495.

exam.format: Online, proctored multiple-choice exam: 60 questions in 90 minutes. No prerequisites. The exam follows MCP specification version 2026-07-28.

discounts.text: Buying the exam through an Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) event registration saves 20%.

access.retake: One free retake is included if the first attempt is not passed; it must be taken within the 12 months of eligibility that start at purchase, with no enforced wait beyond scoring (up to 24 hours) and the 24-hour booking lead time.
access.accommodations: Candidates with disabilities send the Test Accommodations Form at least two weeks before the exam, before scheduling it; requests are reviewed case by case.

scope: MCP fundamentals, architecture, interaction/execution, security/governance and use cases. The listing references specification version 2026-07-28.
ai_policy: Exam resource rules must be checked before booking.
caveats: Duration conflict: the 14 September 2026 launch release says 120 minutes, while the current certification page and the Linux Foundation multiple-choice FAQ both say 90 minutes, which is used here. The 60-question count and 75% pass mark come from the Linux Foundation multiple-choice exam instructions and FAQ linked from the certification page.

prep.title: Model Context Protocol specification, version 2026-07-28
prep.note: The version the certification page tells candidates to study.
